run_pnacl_clang: run sz_driver.py to pass arguments directly to pnacl-clang compiler
run_pnacl_clang_cpp: run sz_driver.py with is_cpp=True to invoke pnacl-clang++ for C++ compilation
subsToMacros_generate: call subsToMacros to generate C macro definitions from a dictionary of function signatures
run_asan_instrument: run sz_driver.py with -fsanitize-address to redefine memory allocation functions for instrumentation
run_no_inline: run sz_driver.py with -fno-inline to prevent clang from inlining memory allocation functions
